summary: Managed club identity (clubId/short) must select First Team via club-object PRE_NAME → mid-file team body → persist-tid 7f02 job-list. Manager-hit ranking alone can prefer a foreign squad list while clubName stays Schalke.

employmentRule.definition: Employed by managed club = jobId sits on that club's unit squad list (FT club-object→7f02; II affiliate join; U19 namelist). Mentoring pool = FT employees ∩ ¬loanedOut.
employmentRule.t009: When club short is known, join miss yields empty FT (method ft-club-squad-join-miss) — never pick_tid fallback. Foreign/decoy persistTid jobs must not enter players[] or Mentoring.

discovery.input: managed parent short name from discover_managed_club (e.g. Schalke 04)
steps: Find lp32 parent short in catalog (≤20MB); require PRE_NAME motif immediately before the name (skips human-identity short without PRE_NAME)
Before PRE_NAME read <teamId:u32le> <dup:u32le>×2 (dups equal, not sentinel; teamId in 100..50000)
In mid-file (~40–100MB) find team body: <teamId> | 00×10 | <u32> | <dup>×2 | 0a … (same body layout as II)
Within +128 bytes of body teamId find <persistTid:u32le> | 7f 02 00 00 00 ff×4 | <count:u16∈[15,45]> | <jobs:u32×n>
Use persistTid + jobs as First Team (do not let pick_tid manager ranking override when this join hits; refuse pick_tid entirely when identity known)

falsePositives.pick_tid manager_hits only: Identity OK + wrong ranked squad — foreign FT cards under Schalke clubName
falsePositives.reuse II teamId threshold dup>1000: Schalke FT club-object dup is 919; allow dup≥100
falsePositives.II subunit ff|00|ff header: FT list is 7f02 persist-tid path, not subunit header

Schalke 04.note: verification outputs — do not hardcode as discovery inputs
